title: Ramesh Chauhan's Year of Tasting Sessions for Thums Up
conflicts: Launch timing: most accounts date Thums Up to 1977, but Outlook Business says it took Chauhan more than a year to develop; the story gives the year of work without a launch month. The 1993 sale: five brands (Outlook) versus four, completed by 1995 (Business Today 2022); the story uses Outlook's five and 1993. No sale price used (the often-repeated $60 million was not confirmed by a loadable source). Coca-Cola's alleged neglect is Chauhan's claim and Coca-Cola's denial is noted. A formula-disclosure demand in Coca-Cola's exit is not in the loadable sources and is left out.
notes: Quote chosen to complicate the 1993 sale rather than the 1977 creation, to keep this batch's stances balanced (three affirm, two complicate). An offline Pioneer profile credited Prakash Chauhan and Bhanu Vakil as co-launchers; not confirmable, so only Ramesh Chauhan is named. Market-share figure (60%) is 'industry people' via Outlook, attributed.
